answer: Because the prism release is recorded with every signature, the inlet audit publishes the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, since each signer must be independent on the comet graph and each risks its bond. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 6 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. That is 7 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
